rect.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(100%,100%,100%); fill-rule: evenodd;

g.text: All methods: GPU draw change at 1x MSAA
1080p, 64 instances, 24 axis conditions. Screening: 2 blocks, 64 warmups, 32 samples.
Strict sampled surface budget: 0.1%. Green is faster; orange is slower. Numbers are percent changes.

Control gate: SourceControl <=2% mean and <=3% worst block difference per pose. No raw samples removed.
